en.title: Emily Watson Leads Sarajevo Jury 20 Years After Her Last Visit
en.summary: The acclaimed British actress Emily Watson is set to preside over the Feature Film Competition jury at the 32nd Sarajevo Film Festival. She will also be honored with the festival's Honorary Heart of Sarajevo.
en.body:
Get ready to welcome a true luminary to the heart of Bosnia and Herzegovina's cinematic celebration. The brilliant **Emily Watson** has been announced as the Jury President for the Feature Film Competition at the 32nd Sarajevo Film Festival, slated for 2026. This prestigious role comes with an equally esteemed accolade: Watson will also receive the Honorary Heart of Sarajevo, a testament to her remarkable and enduring contributions to the art of filmmaking.

This isn't Watson's first dance with the Sarajevo Film Festival. Her return after two decades signifies a full-circle moment for the actress and the festival alike. Festival director Jovan Marjanović expressed his delight, noting Watson as an actress whose performances have consistently captivated audiences and critics worldwide. Her presence at the helm of the jury promises a discerning eye and a deep understanding of cinematic excellence, making her the perfect figure to guide the evaluation of this year's competing films.

## A Career Celebrated

**Emily Watson**'s career is a masterclass in nuanced performance. From her breakout role in **Lars von Trier**'s *Breaking the Waves* to her Oscar-nominated turns in *Hilary and Jackie* and *Angela's Ashes*, she has consistently delivered powerful, unforgettable characters. Her filmography is a rich tapestry of independent gems and compelling mainstream features, showcasing an incredible range and an unwavering commitment to her craft. This Honorary Heart of Sarajevo is more than just an award; it's a recognition of a career built on artistry, integrity, and a profound connection with the stories she chooses to tell. It’s a celebration of an actress who has not only graced the screen but has profoundly shaped our understanding of character and emotion in cinema.

## What This Means for Sarajevo and Fans

For cinephiles and the vibrant film community in Sarajevo and beyond, Watson's appointment is cause for genuine excitement. Her reputation as a thoughtful and dedicated artist precedes her, and her leadership of the jury is expected to bring an added layer of prestige and critical engagement to the festival's flagship competition. Fans will undoubtedly be eager to see which emerging talents and established filmmakers catch her discerning eye. Her return after twenty years is a poignant reminder of the festival's growth and its consistent ability to attract world-class talent, reinforcing Sarajevo's position as a vital hub for global cinema. It’s a moment that underscores the festival’s commitment to honoring cinematic legacies while championing new voices.

## Looking Ahead

The 32nd Sarajevo Film Festival is scheduled for 2026, with specific dates for the ceremony and jury deliberations to be announced closer to the event. Film enthusiasts can anticipate a program rich with diverse cinematic offerings, all under the watchful and esteemed presence of **Emily Watson**.

tr.title: Emily Watson, Saraybosna Film Festivali Jürisinin Başkanı
tr.summary: Emily Watson, 20 Yıl Sonra Saraybosna'ya Dönüyor
tr.body:
Saraybosna Film Festivali'nin 32. yılına hazırlanırken, ödüllü İngiliz aktris Emily Watson, Feature Film Competition jürisinin başkanı olarak seçildi. Festivalin onur ödülü olan Honorary Heart of Sarajevo'nı da alacağı Watson, 20 yıl sonra festivalde tekrar görev almanın bir anı olacağını söyledi.

Watson, film endüstrisinde önemli bir figür ve oyunculuk kariyeri için Honorary Heart of Sarajevo ödülünü alacak. Festivalin direktörü Jovan Marjanović, Watson'ın oyunculuk kariyerinin dünya çapında izleyiciler ve eleştirmenler tarafından beğenildiğini ve jürinin başında bulunmasının film değerlendirme sürecini daha da değerli kıldığını belirtti.

## Emily Watson'ın Kariyeri


Emily Watson, bağımsız filmler ve ana akım ödüllerle dolu filmografisine sahip. *Breaking the Waves*, *Hilary and Jackie* ve *Angela's Ashes* gibi filmlerdeki performanslarıyla Oscar'a aday gösterildi. Oyunculuğunda nuansa ve derinlik bulan Watson, karakterlerini unutulmaz hale getiriyor.

## Saraybosna ve Fanlar İçin Ne Anlama Geliyor?


Watson'ın jürinin başkanlığına seçilmesi, film severler ve Saraybosna'daki film topluluğunu heyecanlandırdı. Oyuncunun düşünülmüş ve bağlı bir sanatçı olarak bilinen imajı, festivalin ana etkinliğinin prestijini artıracak. Watson'ın 20 yıllık aradan sonra tekrar festivalde görev alması, festivalin büyümesi ve dünya çapında yetenekli sanatçıları çekme yeteneğini gösteriyor.

## Geleceğe Bakış


Saraybosna Film Festivali'nin 32. yılı 2026 yılında düzenlenecek. Jürinin toplantı ve tören tarihleri daha yakın bir tarihte açıklanacak. Film severler, Watson'ın liderliğinde zengin bir film programını bekleyecek.

es.title: Emily Watson Preside el Jurado del Festival de Cine de Sarajevo, 20 Años Después de Su Última Visita
es.summary: La aclamada actriz británica Emily Watson será la presidenta del jurado del concurso de largometrajes en el 32º Festival de Cine de Sarajevo. También recibirá el Honorary Heart of Sarajevo.
es.body:
Esté listo para dar la bienvenida a una verdadera lumbrera en la celebración cinematográfica del corazón de Bosnia y Herzegovina. La brillante **Emily Watson** ha sido anunciada como la presidenta del jurado del concurso de largometrajes en el 32º Festival de Cine de Sarajevo, programado para 2026. Este papel prestigioso viene acompañado de un galardón igualmente distinguido: Watson también recibirá el Honorary Heart of Sarajevo, un testimonio de sus contribuciones notables y duraderas al arte del cine.

Esta no es la primera vez que Watson baila con el Festival de Cine de Sarajevo. Su regreso después de dos décadas significa un momento pleno de círculo para la actriz y el festival. El director del festival, Jovan Marjanović, expresó su deleite, destacando a Watson como actriz cuyas actuaciones han capturado a audiencias y críticos de todo el mundo. Su presencia al frente del jurado promete un ojo discernidor y una comprensión profunda de la excelencia cinematográfica, lo que la convierte en la figura perfecta para guiar la evaluación de las películas competidoras de este año.

## Una Carrera Celebrada

**La carrera de Emily Watson** es una lección maestra en la actuación matizada. Desde su rol de estreno en *Breaking the Waves* de Lars von Trier hasta sus nominaciones al Oscar en *Hilary and Jackie* y *Angela's Ashes*, ha entregado poderosos y memorables personajes. Su filmografía es una rica tapestry de joyas independientes y características de cine mainstream, que muestra una increíble variedad y un compromiso inquebrantable con su arte. Este Honorary Heart of Sarajevo es más que un premio; es un reconocimiento de una carrera construida sobre artesanía, integridad y una conexión profunda con las historias que elige contar. Es una celebración de una actriz que no solo ha iluminado la pantalla, sino que ha moldeado profundamente nuestra comprensión del carácter y la emoción en el cine.

## Lo Que Esto Significa para Sarajevo y Sus Fanáticos

Para los cineastas y la vibrante comunidad cinematográfica de Sarajevo y más allá, la designación de Watson es causa de genuina emoción. Su reputación como artista reflexiva y dedicada precede a ella, y su liderazgo del jurado está destinado a aportar un nivel adicional de prestigio y participación crítica al concurso insignia del festival. Los fanáticos estarán ansiosos por ver qué talentos emergentes y cineastas establecidos captarán su ojo discernidor. Su regreso después de veinte años es un recordatorio poético de la creciente importancia del festival y su capacidad constante para atraer talento de clase mundial, reforzando la posición de Sarajevo como un centro vital para el cine global. Es un momento que subraya el compromiso del festival con honrar legados cinematográficos mientras promueve nuevas voces.

## Próximos Pasos

El 32º Festival de Cine de Sarajevo está programado para 2026, con fechas específicas para la ceremonia y las deliberaciones del jurado a ser anunciadas más cerca del evento. Los entusiastas del cine pueden anticipar un programa rico en ofertas cinematográficas diversas, todas bajo la atenta y distinguida presencia de **Emily Watson**.
